en: Multiview color postcard showing four views of Gura Humorului, Suceava County: a large socialist-era administrative building with a rooftop slogan, a modern building with a fountain, the chalet-style Motelul Ariniș amid trees, and a street scene of the town center. A coat of arms appears in the middle. The reverse is in Romanian (with some French), printed by Poșta Română with a 40 bani indicia and address lines.
